planets.name: TOI-1648 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-1648 with a 7.33-day year, found in 2025.

text.card: TOI-1648 b was found in 2025 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-1648. Its orbit and size follow Carleo et al. 2026's fit, the archive's default.
